text:
Evan T: hey folks  quick one: I'm a part-time engineer (60%) and we're moving from foster care placement to formal adoption in a few weeks. how does the company parental top-up work for part-time schedules and what paperwork should I prep early?
Marina (People Ops): congrats, Evan! short answer: top-up is pro-rated to your FTE. submit the parental_leave_request and set FTE=60% so payroll calculates pro-rata. file as soon as you have a placement window even if tentative.
Evan T: great. any docs I should get before the placement to avoid delays?
Ruth (Benefits): helpful docs: placement letter from agency, foster placement agreement, ID, and any court notices if available. upload to the secure HR portal within 30 days of the start date. for foster-to-adopt we accept interim placement docs to pre-authorize top-up.
Jordan (Payroll): payroll note: we use code FOST_ADOPT_TOPUP. if you file with FTE specified before the payroll cutoff (Fri 3pm PT) changes are seamless. for part-time employees we calculate top-up based on your regular scheduled hours. if hours change during leave, notify payroll@redwood.com.
Sam (Eng Lead): Evan, let's do a 20m handoff tomorrow to map critical tasks and reduce context switching. also nominate a backup for oncall.
Evan T: thanks Sam, will do. question: can the top-up cover travel for court/agency meetings?
Ruth (Benefits): travel for placement-related court or agency meetings may be eligible under FAMILY_TRAVEL if documented. caps apply; submit receipts via expenses with code FAMILY_TRAVEL. taxability will be reviewed based on jurisdiction.
Marina (People Ops): coverage ops: please create a 1-page runbook and list two owners. People Ops can also coordinate a phased return (up to 60% workload) if you want that option. mark phased_return: yes on the form.
Evan T: timeline-wise, if placement shifts 3 days, do I need to re-file?
Jordan (Payroll): refile only if the confirmed start date changes. put flex_start: yes on the form for uncertainty. if date changes after payroll cutoff we may need a small retro but we try to handle same-cycle when possible. email payroll@redwood.com ASAP after changes.
hr-bot: Ticket created: FOSTADOPT-1796001111. A People Ops specialist will reach out within 2 business days to schedule a call.
Evan T: perfect  appreciate the quick help. I'll submit the form and drop the runbook shortly. :thumbsup:
